name: a2_farm_scale
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 2 (Sec. 7.1, Table 3) - EFFECT OF THE SCALE OF AVERAGE FARM SIZE.
    Multiply every farm area by k (budget per hectare held constant, i.e. budgets scale with area, as in
    the paper) and track when solo participation becomes feasible, how the cooperative gain shrinks as
    farms grow (solo farmers no longer need the coalition to amortise certification), and how the
    stability of the allocation rules changes.  Paper grid: k = 1, 3, 5, 10; extended with 0.5 and 2-20.
